head: LayerLoops lets you draw shapes and record video inside them
dek: LayerLoops is a camera app where you draw on the screen and record live video into what you drew, building a video out of layers. It was #33 among paid Photo & Video apps on the US App Store on 11 November.
details: You can start from a new recording or a video or image from your library. It costs $5.99 with no in-app purchases, by Anton Repponen, and needs iOS 18.5.
means: Creators get an easy way to make collage-style videos on the phone.
todo: Find LayerLoops in the App Store.
thumb_words: DRAW, THEN FILL IT WITH VIDEO
